text:
olivia: Quick pulse — propulsion catalog ingest for the new open set (orchid-lite + beacon3b). Need owners for: licensing sign-off, perf baseline, and manifest shape migration. ETA for each?
ashok: I can own perf baseline. Will run perf on staging GPU pool, push profiles to /perf/reports. ETA: EOD Wed. Any preferred workloads/seeds?
claire: I’ll take licensing handoff. @legal-bot can you surface any red flags for beacon3b? License header says Apache-2 + additional upstream terms.
legal-bot: Automated check: beacon3b sources include third-party weights (flag: provenance_missing). Action: upload license bundle to /legal/incoming and tag procurement if proprietary blobs present. :warning:
samir: Manifest note — current ingest schema expects embeddings_shape=(2048,) but beacon3b yields 1536. I’ll add a lightweight reproject step in the ingest pipeline. Plan: open CR for a shim + unit tests. Example snippet for manifest change:
```
"embeddings": {"shape": [1536], "dtype": "fp16"}
```
marta: Heads-up: routing/canary needs perf profile by Thu for canary slot allocation. Also want an explicit rollback proposal (variant to fallback to).
ashok: Thu AM profile upload is doable. For rollback propose fallback to beacon3b-quant (lower quality, low-latency). @infra-bot please reserve a canary slot on 2023-11-02T08:00Z for this model.
infra-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2023-11-02T08:00Z — queue ID #c-4821. Notifying routing team.
claire: I’ll try to have the license bundle by Wed noon. One potential blocker: need confirmation on downstream use-case disclosures for third-party dataset terms.
legal-bot: If third-party weights are involved, procurement review may be required. Please tag @procurement and attach the weight provenance report.
olivia: Quick summary/action items: 1) Ashok — perf baseline by Wed EOD -> upload to /perf/reports/beacon3b-<ts>. 2) Claire — license bundle to /legal/incoming by Wed noon (flag procurement if needed). 3) Samir — manifest shim CR and tests (estimate: 1 day). 4) Marta — confirm canary schedule once perf file exists. Ping me when all green and I’ll kick the catalog ingestion. Thanks all :thumbsup:
